description: This file defines a Java interface 'PaymentTypeReadPlatformService' that declares methods for retrieving payment type data in the Fineract project.

classes.name: PaymentTypeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for reading payment type data, including retrieving all payment types, all with code, and one by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllPaymentTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all payment types.

methods.name: retrieveAllPaymentTypesWithCode
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all payment types with their associated codes.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific payment type by its ID.
